data.name: Rameshwari
data.gender_notes: Rameshwari is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rameshwari is a combination of two words, Rama and Ishwari. Rama is the name of a popular Hindu god, and Ishwari is a term for Goddess or Divine Mother. So, Rameshwari means 'Goddess Rama's Grace'. It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of strength, courage, and femininity. The name Rameshwari carries the meaning “Goddess Rama's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rameshwari usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess rama's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rameshwari is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is a reminder of the divine presence that is always with us and the grace and blessings of the goddess. It is a name that inspires devotion, faith, and a deep connection to the spiritual world.
data.etymology: Rameshwari belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Rama's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rameshwari total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rameshwari holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology. Rama, one of the most revered deities in Hinduism, is known for his unwavering devotion to his wife Sita, which is an embodiment of true love and fidelity. The name Rameshwari thus signifies the power, grace, and devotion of this divine couple.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rameshwari has deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the divine grace and blessings of Goddess Rama. It signifies the presence of the divine feminine and the power of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name also symbolizes strength, courage, and resilience, inspiring those who bear it to face challenges with grace and determination. Ultimately, Rameshwari is a name that connects one to the divine and the eternal, offering a constant reminder of the power and grace of the deities Rama and Ishwari.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rameshwari is a name derived from the combination of two Sanskrit words - Rama and Ishwari. Rama represents the divine prince of Ayodhya and an embodiment of virtue and righteousness. Ishwari signifies the Goddess or the consort of Shiva, symbolizing divine grace and compassion. In essence, Rameshwari represents the divine fusion of virtue, righteousness, grace, and compassion.
